title: No originator==receiver self-announce suppression surface in Python
description: test/vectors/announce_relay.json edge_cases vector first_announce_from_self expects drop with reason self_announce when originator_iid == receiver IID. No Python surface implements this: AnnounceProcessor.process() has no receiver-identity parameter and no self-announce reject reason, and Node._process_announce() does not compare announce.originator_iid against the local node's own IID (both read; no filter found). Decide whether the filter belongs in Node (own-TX loopback guard) or the processor, add a surface, then consume the vector. Partition currently enforced by UNDRIVABLE_ANNOUNCE in python/tests/test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py::test_announce_relay_vector_coverage.
